hints.title: Subarray Boundary Condition
hints.text: A subarray nums[i..j] is valid if greatest common divisor of nums[i] and nums[j] is strictly greater than 1.

hints.title: Prefix Subproblem
hints.text: Let dp[i] represent the minimum number of valid subarrays needed to partition the prefix nums[0..i-1].

hints.title: State Extension
hints.text: From each reached index i with valid dp[i], test all end indices j >= i where gcd(nums[i], nums[j]) > 1 and update dp[j + 1] = min(dp[j + 1], dp[i] + 1).

hints.title: Linear Subproblem Table Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing all pairs (i, j) with Euclidean greatest common divisor computation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive exploration of all partition splits leads to 2^n exponential search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space for the 1D prefix table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Defines optimal prefix subproblems and evaluates boundary gcd constraints.
